label: The First Way conclusion from the MOTION_3 first holder and two sense bridges
meaning: From the MOTION_3 first holder, under double negation, take f that holds some other x in r and is held in no respect. The mover-side bridge gives a respect s in which f moves x (MovesIn, MOTION_1). If f were moved (MovedIn, MOTION_1) in some respect t, the moved-side bridge would make it MOTION_3 held in some respect, which it is not. So f moves something and is moved in no respect: the First-Way reading for the supplied MovedIn and MovesIn, the absolute First-Way conclusion c1b68c21. The companion firstUnheldHolder_iff_reading records that the MOTION_3 first holder is that same reading with MovedIn and MovesIn read as holding; the two open bridges are what carries it to the route's MOTION_1 reading, and each is needed (controls parts 4 and 5). Passage between senses happens only through the two bridges, from MOTION_3 to MOTION_1. It identifies the first mover with nothing and says nothing of potency or God. A support option for c1b68c21 beside the prima via proofs a8ced49e and d337ab29, sharing none of their premises; its weakest points are the two bridges and the lackability premises, with the objections recorded on each.
